title: tecoma haemantha
intro: Tecoma haemantha, commonly known as the Scarlet Trumpet Vine or Cardinal Trumpet, is a species of flowering plant in the family Bignoniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma haemantha include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of fever and respiratory infections, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential health benefits and bioactive constituents of this plant.
